result.line: Hired keeper EOA for 0x43637877's BULL/iBULL NAV-arb shop: calls two executors it doesn't own (0xfc4a89, 0x0c8314, deployed hours earlier by the owner) with pre-computed routes; profits (bash.02-$1.71 USDC, up to 0.193 wHYPE per call; sample of 28 successes over 13 min-4.5 h) all route to the owner, keeper paid out-of-band ~0.045 HYPE (~$3) per batch (2 in 63 min, gross ~$140/day), gas $0.01-$0.94/call; 4 caller EOAs compete (many FAILED). A fresh address gets no on-chain pay.
